name: Law Fist
description: Strike with a closed fist carrying the first law of the canon so it cannot be turned from its mark.

name: Unbending Guard
description: Hold the arms in a guard of ordered qi that gives way to no force however heavy.

name: Edict Stride
description: Stride forward on a fixed edict of distance that the ground itself seems to allow.

name: Iron Statute
description: Lay an iron statute of stillness on a foe's legs so the body cannot step from where it stands.

name: Straight Verdict
description: Deliver a thrust along the one straight line that the law sets between user and target.

name: Rule Ward
description: Hold a ward written in the rules of the school that turns away every blow of a lesser kind.

name: Edict Crash
description: Bring the full weight of an edict down in one blow that breaks stone walls and bone alike.

name: Seal Decree
description: Decree a seal on a foe's whole qi reserve so no technique of its own can be drawn.

name: Law Absolute
description: Pronounce the law in full over one great foe so it is struck down and pinned beneath that weight.

name: Seal Fist
description: Strike with a fist that leaves a faint mark of order qi on the point it touches.

name: Ordinance Guard
description: Turn each attack on a fixed angle laid down by ordinance so the guard needs no thought.

name: Sealed Stride
description: Stride so close to a sealed foe that its slowed reply cannot catch the user.

name: Mark Reading
description: Read the seals placed on a body or an object and know who set them and how strong they hold.

name: Wax Seal
description: Press a seal of qi onto a foe's hand so the technique it was forming cannot finish.

name: Stamped Order
description: Stamp a foe's chest with a mark that makes its limbs obey the user's slow commands.

name: Unseal Friend
description: Break a hostile seal or binding laid on an ally and restore the flow it had choked.

name: Chain Seal
description: Link seals across a foe's body until each of its main channels is shut by a different mark.

name: Seal Rebound
description: Set a seal on the user's guard that returns a technique to its caster at its full strength.

name: Great Seal
description: Set the great seal over a single powerful foe so its qi and its movement both lie locked in place.

name: Account Strike
description: Strike a fist into the foe and enter the weight of the blow upon the grand ledger.

name: Audit Guard
description: Raise a guard that counts the force of each blow it takes and enters it in the book.

name: Page Turn
description: Turn from one stance to the next in a single step as one turns a clean page.

name: Running Tally
description: Keep a running tally in the mind of all force exchanged and the sum now owed to the user.

name: Credit Surge
description: Draw on the force already entered as credit to strengthen the user's next three blows.

name: Lien Strike
description: Strike a foe and leave a lien of qi that adds weight to every later blow the user lands.

name: Interest Bind
description: Bind a foe so the hold grows tighter each breath it struggles against it.

name: Sum Return
description: Return the stored sum of the foe's last blows through the guard in a single reflected pulse.

name: Debt Collapse
description: Call in a heavy debt of force from all foes in an area so each is struck at once.

name: Total Audit
description: Audit a foe's whole stock of qi and bar every technique worth more than the rest it holds.

name: Grand Reckoning
description: Call the entire grand ledger due and loose all force ever owed in one blow upon the foes in reach.

name: Gauge Palm
description: Strike with a palm gauged to the foe's own guard so the force is neither more nor less than needed.

name: Precise Guard
description: Raise a guard with exactly the strength of the strike that comes and not a grain more.

name: Precise Pace
description: Cover the exact gap to the foe in one pace that no sudden shift can spoil.

name: Unerring Eye
description: Judge distance and force by eye without error and call each blow's weight before it lands.

name: Fine Calibration
description: Calibrate the user's qi down to the finest portion so no technique spends more than it should.

name: Twin Weight
description: Meet a blow with its twin in weight and send it away with an answering strike at once.

name: Cancel Force
description: Cancel an incoming force with its opposite so the two cease together in the air.

name: Calm Correction
description: Correct a wounded ally's disordered qi down to the finest detail and clear any poison in it.

name: Narrow Margin
description: Thrust through the narrowest gap in a guard with no spare force to waste.

name: Absolute Parity
description: Force every fighter in reach down to the same output as the weakest so none holds an edge.

name: Exact Return
description: Return a heavy blow to its sender with exactly its own force and nothing taken from it.

name: Zero Margin
description: Strike with a measure so exact that a foe's own defence is counted at nothing and cannot soften the blow.

name: Strand Palm
description: Strike with a palm that sends a thread of qi into the foe to begin the lattice.

name: Woven Guard
description: Hold a guard woven as a fine lattice of qi that spreads the force of a blow over every strand.

name: Weaver Step
description: Step between the lattice threads as a weaver's shuttle passes between the warp.

name: Thread Count
description: Feel every thread in the lattice and the weight of each foe caught in it.

name: Follow-On Bind
description: Bind each limb in turn so that every motion the foe tries only draws another thread tight.

name: Consequence Strike
description: Strike where the lattice says the next movement must go and meet the foe on arrival.

name: Taut Thread
description: Draw a thread taut across a foe's technique so it snaps at the first attempt to use it.

name: Necessity Net
description: Spread the lattice as a net over an area and close it round every foe caught within.

name: Collapse the Weave
description: Let the whole lattice fall inward in one crush that crumples all that was held in it.

name: Inevitable Pattern
description: Complete the lattice so every path of the foe leads to the same strike and the user delivers it.

name: Plumb Fist
description: Drop a fist along the vertical line from above onto the crown of a lowered guard.

name: Upright Guard
description: Stand upright in a guard so straight that force striking it runs down the line into the ground.

name: Vertical Step
description: Rise and drop in a single vertical pace that puts the user over a low sweep.

name: Plunging Thrust
description: Thrust straight down along the falling line to pierce the guard from above.

name: Level Check
description: Check an opponent's body against the plumb line to find which side bears more weight.

name: True Drop
description: Drag a foe's balance straight down along the line so its stance sinks and gives way.

name: Plumb Ruin
description: Drop a heavy stroke along the exact line of a stone pillar or a thick plate and split it through.

name: Moored Tether
description: Hang a line of qi from a foe's centre to the ground and hold it from flight or leap.

name: Unfailing Plumb
description: Deliver the vertical stroke that never deviates by a hair and brings down any one target beneath it.

name: Hold Palm
description: Strike a palm onto a gathering technique and feel its pattern lock in place under the hand.

name: Pause Guard
description: Raise a guard that halts a lesser technique where it meets the qi on the guard.

name: Steady Walk
description: Walk steadily into the area of a stilled technique without being struck by its leftover force.

name: Halting Hand
description: Raise a hand that stops a rising attack from forming at the instant it begins.

name: Pattern Reader
description: Read the pattern of any technique in flight and name the point where it can be stopped.

name: Arrested Motion
description: Hold a technique motionless in the air a moment before it strikes anyone.

name: Take Apart
description: Pull the held technique into its parts with both hands until nothing remains to strike.

name: Rebuild Whole
description: Rebuild an ally's broken technique and clear the curse that kept it from forming.

name: Settled Law
description: Settle an ally's qi into law so that their next technique takes shape without fail.

name: Stilled Storm
description: Still a wide storm of loose techniques until every one hangs motionless in the air.

name: Dismantle Art
description: Dismantle a gathered great technique and scatter its parts before they can be used again.

name: Void the Art
description: Nullify a single incoming technique outright so no trace of its force reaches the user.

name: Technique Suspension
description: Suspend every technique in a wide area and absorb the stilled force into the user's reserve.

name: Domain Palm
description: Strike with a palm inside the orderly domain and feel the blow land with its full weight.

name: Gathered Guard
description: Gather allies under the domain's guard so each stands in line with the next.

name: Ordered Walk
description: Walk the domain in set lines where no stray force reaches the user.

name: Muster Sense
description: Know at once the place and the state of every person within the domain.

name: Quiet Rule
description: Pass a quiet rule through the domain and dull every disruptive technique used within it.

name: Orderly Mend
description: Draw wounded allies in the domain back toward their whole form as the order of their bodies returns.

name: Domain Strike
description: Strike the domain's floor so a flat shock runs through the legs of all foes within.

name: Disorder Banned
description: Bar disorder from the domain so no confusion or panic technique can take hold in it.

name: Order Restored
description: Restore the shaken qi of all allies in the domain and strip away curses and taints.

name: Sovereign Order
description: Proclaim the domain's order as law so techniques of a chosen kind fail within it and allies stand guarded.

name: Gauge Fist
description: Strike with a fist whose qi is regulated to a single steady pitch from start to finish.

name: Regulated Guard
description: Regulate the guard's strength moment by moment so it never flags or surges.

name: Governed Step
description: Govern each stride so its force and distance match the step before it exactly.

name: Pulse Reading
description: Read the flow of qi in a body from the pulse and know where it surges or lapses.

name: Even Flow
description: Regulate an ally's qi into an even flow so their techniques land cleanly and cost less.

name: Surge Damp
description: Damp a foe's surge of qi so its next technique comes out weak and ragged.

name: Lapse Fill
description: Fill a lapse in an ally's flow of qi before it can open a gap in their guard.

name: Deviation Cure
description: Cure an ally's Qi Deviation by regulating the wild flow back into its proper channels.

name: Governing Hand
description: Take the governing of a foe's qi in one hand and slow its flow to a trickle.

name: Regulation Wave
description: Send a wave of regulation across a wide group of allies to steady their qi and clear its faults.

name: Perfect Flow
description: Make every ally's qi flow perfect and unbroken so no surge or lapse can mar their defence.

name: Axiom Fist
description: Strike with a fist that follows from a first truth of force and so cannot miss its reasoning.

name: Premise Guard
description: Deflect a blow by the first premise of the school so the answer is always at hand.

name: Proof Step
description: Take a step that proves the position of the user in a single stroke of movement.

name: Corollary
description: Follow a first blow with the second that must follow from it and cannot be avoided.

name: Deduction
description: Deduce from three blows exchanged the next five and the one that ends the exchange.

name: Contradiction
description: Show a foe's technique to contradict itself so its structure breaks apart as it is used.

name: Theorem Strike
description: Strike by a proven theorem of force that goes through any guard not built on the same truth.

name: Self-Evident Ward
description: Raise a ward so plainly grounded in law that no blow can argue its way through.

name: Final Proof
description: Close the argument of the fight with one blow that ends it and needs no second.
